status_note: First oracle pin of the Scope::addMap property fold (database.cc:1149-1153) and the Database flagbase partmap (database.cc:3220-3265, partmap.hh:50-160): 24 records byte-identical on both sides, including the hole-vs-mapsym document-order interleave, the partition accumulate/sub-range-clear semantics, the encode/decode changepoint round-trip, the victim construction order and the global-discovery uselimit clear. Overall UNTESTED: production install call sites still thread the zero-property context (the arch→Database unification gap) and the space-top open-end sentinel stays unported.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: addMap mutates entry.symbol->flags by REFERENCE (symbol-level, shared across the Symbol's entries) and clears entry.uselimit in place on a global-discovery hit (database.cc:1131-1142); setPropertyRange/clearPropertyRange mutate the shared flagbase partitions in place; queryProperties' uint4&flags side-output observes getAllFlags (database.hh:271) or the scope/property branches (database.cc:1270/1273-1276/1279).
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: The set/clear walk runs aiter=flagbase.begin(addr1) (lower_bound, partmap.hh:70) to biter=begin(addr2)|end() — partitions of [getFirstAddr, getLastAddrOpen) in Address natural order; <hole> children apply setPropertyRange at their DOCUMENT POSITION inside <symbollist> (database.cc:2768-2784) so a mapsym before the hole never folds and one after does; the fold reads the property at entry.addr (the mapping START) exactly once.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: Partition values accumulate bitwise: |= flags on set (database.cc:3236), &= ~flags on clear (database.cc:3261) — overlapping ranges stack (readonly|volatile=0x2800) and a sub-range clear leaves neighbours' bits intact; symbol flags accumulate per mapping (|= persist at 1132/1139, |= addrtied|property at 1150-1153) and never un-fold, so construction order is observable (the victim case).
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: The flagbase is std::map<Address,uint4> under Address natural ordering — space index first, then offset (address.hh:375-396); getValue is upper_bound-then-step-back with the 0 default before the first split (partmap.hh:83-93, database.cc:2929); split copies the preceding partition's value (partmap.hh:119-134); encode emits the split points in that order.

analysis_options.api: Direct Database::{setPropertyRange, clearPropertyRange, getProperty, encode, decode}, Scope::addMapSym (via <db>/<scope> decode), Scope::addSymbol/addMapPoint -> Scope::addMap and rudra::database::{Database, Scope, PartMap, AddMapContext} + rudra::varmap::ScopeLocal::{install_symbol_addmap, add_map_entry_with_property, query_properties_ex} invocations; no ActionGroup or other Action runs
analysis_options.ghidra_funcdata: Locked BfdArchitecture over the pinned examples/curl input supplies the Ghidra Funcdata, address spaces, TypeFactory, live symboltab flagbase and the persistent ScopeLocal (function GetStr at 0x36d0); property ranges go through the production Database::setPropertyRange / decodeHole paths; symbols install through Scope::addSymbol (production addMap); every qp observable comes from the REAL Scope::queryProperties return
analysis_options.rugra_scope: Rugra drives rudra::database::Database with the PartMap flagbase (set/clear/encode/decode), hand-built marshal <db> documents for the hole/mapsym interleave, and an isolated ScopeLocal whose install paths carry the flagbase closure (the production seam models the glb->symboltab handle); ghidra_space_index pins const=0 unique=2 ram=3 stack=8 as printed by the live oracle
analysis_options.ir: No P-code ops are constructed; the observable is exclusively flagbase partition values, changepoint sequences, per-query queryProperties returns (entry identity + flags hex + answering scope) and decoded getAllFlags projections
analysis_options.normalization: No Ghidra/Rugra behavior difference is normalized or removed. The C++ dump keeps std::hex sticky across offset/size/flags; the Rust fixture formats all of them as hex explicitly. Loader warnings route into an in-fixture ostringstream (both stderr streams empty and hash-pinned); the decodeInterleave property samples read glb->symboltab — the seam ScopeInternal::decodeHole actually writes through (database.cc:2684) — which the production Rust decode models as the Database being decoded itself. Pointer/Arc addresses never appear in the records.
analysis_options.random_seed: none; all queries and construction are deterministic

setup_space_indices.covers: setup record: live oracle indices const=0 unique=2 ram=3 stack=8 equal Rugra ghidra_space_index

flagbase_partition_accumulate.covers: fb_accumulate: overlapping setPropertyRange calls OR into shared partitions (0x2000/0x2800/0x800/0x0 sampled around both boundaries, database.cc:3236)

flagbase_subrange_clear.covers: fb_clear_subrange: clearPropertyRange ANDs away only the listed bits inside [first,last_open) — the hole drops to 0 while both neighbours and the volatile overlap bit survive (database.cc:3260-3265)

flagbase_roundtrip_changepoints.covers: fb_roundtrip(+_prop): encode emits one <property_changepoint> per split point with the cumulative value; decode assigns each split its exact value (database.cc:3273-3288/3325-3335) — the 6-point sequence and 4 samples byte-equal

hole_document_order_interleave.covers: fb_hole_interleave(_flipped): <hole> applies setPropertyRange at its document position (database.cc:2768-2784→2683-2685) — mapsym BEFORE the hole installs without the fold (0x20c000), AFTER folds (0x20e000); hole-first folds both

fold_readonly_after.covers: fold_ro_after: property-first construction — empty-uselimit static map ORs the flagbase bits at entry.addr into the SYMBOL (getAllFlags 0x20a000, database.cc:1149-1153)

fold_overlap_partitions.covers: fold_overlap_both/ro_only/vol_only: the fold reads the property at each mapping START — both bits / readonly-only / volatile-only from the accumulated partitions

fold_tail_start_address.covers: fold_tail_overlap: a range starting INSIDE the symbol extent folds nothing (entry.addr only, 0x208000)

fold_usepoint_guard.covers: fold_usepoint_guard_hit/miss: a usepoint-restricted map takes NEITHER addrtied NOR the fold (bare 0x200000 at the usepoint; scope-only 0x20a000 at invalid)

fold_victim_construction_order.covers: fold_victim_before/scope_only: symbol installed BEFORE the range never folds (0x208000); the property shows only through the query-time getProperty of the scope-only branch (0x20a000, database.cc:1273-1276)

fold_global_persist.covers: fold_global_persist: global-scope symbol in a readonly ram range — persist AND the fold both land (0x20e000, database.cc:1131-1132+1153)

fold_discovery_uselimit_clear.covers: fold_discovery_clear/uselimit: database.cc:1133-1142 — local symbol in the global discovery range with a usepoint gets persist AND its uselimit CLEARED, feeding addrtied+fold so the entry answers at an INVALID usepoint (0x20e000, uselimit_empty=1)

production_database_threading.covers: The fixture injects the flagbase closure / AddMapContext at every fold site; production map-install call sites (varmap add_symbol / add_fake_input paths, database.rs overrideSizeType re-add) still pass the zero-property / None context, so the fold is not observable on the production pipeline until the arch→Database wiring lands.

space_top_open_end_sentinel.covers: The partmap walk uses Range::get_last_addr_open = last.next() as the open end; the Address::m_maximal sentinel for a range running to the exact space top with no later space (address.cc:265-279) is unported — equivalent for getValue queries, but encode would emit a changepoint at space-top+1 for that corner. No fixture case reaches the corner.

branches.detail: Production map-install call sites (varmap add_symbol/add_fake_input paths, database.rs overrideSizeType re-add) pass the zero-property / None context — the arch→Database wiring that supplies the real flagbase lookup is the DB-LOCALSCOPE-MAP-0001 unification itself; fixtures inject the flagbase closure, production cannot yet. Fix = thread the Architecture symboltab handle through the production install paths.

Range::get_last_addr_open has no Address::m_maximal sentinel for the "range runs to the space top and no later space exists" corner (address.cc:265-279): last.next() is used as the open end — equivalent for getValue queries; the residual is a changepoint emitted at space-top+1 in encode for that corner. Fix = port the m_maximal sentinel + getNextSpaceInOrder roll into address.rs.
